verdict.rationale: The evidence pack mentions generic automation ('Automate tasks and workflows with Trello'), calendar sync, and card-button triggers. None of these document scheduling recurring jobs or workflows on a time-based or repeating cadence. Generic or one-off automation and calendar time-blocking do not count as a recurring schedule, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
